verdict.rationale: SumUp is a payments platform, not an AI agent or MCP host. Asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only the opposite role: a managed SumUp MCP server and an Agent Toolkit that expose SumUp tools to other clients. Nothing shows SumUp itself acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
